classes.name: <app>
classes.summary: The only entry module. main() picks a view, builds the one Controller, hands both to the view. Replaces app + app_bootstrap + lifecycle + devices.

members.name: launch
notes: three 390-line launcher functions, each nesting its own setup wizard, become one launch(view_name) over a 3-entry table; the wizards are replaced by the Setup panel

members.name: pick_view
notes: verb scheme; 'select' is reserved for operator selections

classes.name: Setup
classes.summary: The setup panel. Scans ports and gamepads, validates an assignment, constructs Models into the Controller. Rendered by every view's PanelView from its schema, so there is one wizard instead of three.

members.name: scan
notes: progress is part of Setup.state

members.name: scan_gamepads
notes: 'controller' now means only the Controller

classes.name: Controller
classes.summary: Owns every Model. The ONLY object a view talks to. Constructs/destructs models on demand, serialises commands per model, wires the per-model estops into the global one, closes everything exactly once on exit.

members.name: is_estopped
notes: any(model.is_estopped). Drives the global toggle's label.

members.name: clear_estop_all
notes: clear_estop_all(confirmed). One confirmation listing the latched models, then each model's own clear_estop.

members.name: estop_all
notes: wires the per-model estops together (owner ruling)

members.name: remove
notes: destruct on demand: estop, close devices, drop

members.name: reopen
notes: reopen(name): add() again from the config remembered at remove(), so a reopened model is never headless.

members.name: schema
notes: schema(name) -> dict. What a view renders.

members.name: set_input_focus
notes: Forwards window focus to every Gamepad gate. Views no longer reach into probes.

members.name: state
notes: state() for everything, state(name) for one model

members.name: _lock_for
notes: per-model command serialisation now protects all three views, not only Web

members.name: _model
notes: private: views never receive a model

members.name: info

classes.summary: Base of every station model. Owns its Devices, opens/closes them on demand, reports their status in state, and carries the ONE estop latch implementation. Replaces the ManagedModel protocol and three hand-rolled latch copies.

notes: The Devices this model owns.

three names for one act

members.name: _halt_hardware
